Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class AdminReputationService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.AdminReputationService
public class AdminReputationService extends Object
Control class for Task 3.8 Seller Ratings Overview: the seller summary (step 5), a seller's reviews (6.5) and hiding a review (6.6). Every method starts with the admin role check. This class does not use the ui layer.

  • Method Details

    • findSellerRatings

      public List<SellerRating> findSellerRatings(String usernameText)
      Lists the sellers with their rating data for the first view of the Seller Ratings tab, ordered by username. Hidden reviews are not counted (Special Requirement 3).
      Parameters:
      usernameText - part of a seller's username, ignoring case; null or blank for all sellers
      Returns:
      the matching sellers; empty if none match, never null

    • findReviews

      public List<Review> findReviews(ReviewFilter filter)
      Lists reviews for the admin (Task 3.8, 6.5), including hidden ones. Every chosen filter must match; a null filter field means "no filter". Results are sorted newest first. The screen can mark a review the seller flagged with Review.isFlagged().
      Parameters:
      filter - the filter options, or null for no filter
      Returns:
      matching reviews, never null; empty if none match
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the rating filter is outside 1 to 5

    • hideReview

      public void hideReview(String reviewId, String reason)
      Hides a review (Task 3.8, 6.6.4): sets it hidden, records an Audit Log entry with the reason and the admin's username, and notifies the buyer who wrote it and the seller it is about, each with its own wording. The seller's average rating is recalculated automatically, because hidden reviews are not counted.
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the reason is blank (A1), the review does not exist, or it is already hidden

    • findReviewsForSeller

      public List<Review> findReviewsForSeller(String sellerUsername, ReviewFilter filter)
      Returns all reviews (including hidden) written about exactly sellerUsername.
